item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure DocumentDB elasticity—query from any node
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB now lets you send queries to any node in a multi-shard cluster. Each node can answer locally or route the query to the shard or shards holding the data.

  • Source: Azure Updates
